comment_endOfLine: The repo has mixed CRLF/LF files. 'auto' respects whatever each file already uses, which removes ~7000 phantom warnings without rewriting a single line. Switch to 'lf' after a one-off normalisation via .gitattributes.
comment_trailingComma: Must stay 'none' — .eslintrc.cjs sets comma-dangle: never, and Prettier 3 defaults to 'all'. Left unset, the two tools fight and every file loses.
